# Course Objectives

## What Students Should Be Able To Do {.theory-slide}

::: {.theory-card}
- Convert service needs into quantifiable technical requirements.
- Model demand and define KPIs.
- Dimension radio access under coverage and capacity constraints.
- Design transport with latency, aggregation, and reliability in mind.
- Evaluate CAPEX, OPEX, ROI, energy, and regulation.
- Build phased deployment strategies for realistic environments.
:::
